jobs.description:
As a logistics operator, you are responsible for monitoring and managing logistics processes, resolving malfunctions, performing technical interventions, and working with modern systems in an automated cold storage environment. You work in a two-shift system and have a technical affinity.What will you be doing at Agristo?As a logistics operator, you are responsible for: 
• Monitoring and managing the processes within the logistics department to ensure continuity. 
• Identifying and resolving irregularities and malfunctions in the logistics flows. 
• Carrying out minor technical interventions to ensure a safe and smooth flow of goods. 
• Working with modern systems and operating cranes and shuttles in the automated cold storage facility. 
• Interpreting data trends and reporting process information with the aim of contributing to improvement actions for the logistics department.
 
• You have a technical affinity. 
• You hold a valid forklift and reach truck certificate, or you are willing to obtain one. 
• Working in a colder environment doesn’t scare you, and you are not afraid of heights. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.). 
• You are comfortable working with computers and eager to learn new programs. 
• You work efficiently and with respect for safety and quality standards. 
• You have a good command of Dutch, French, or English.

Do you enjoy physical work and don't mind working in a cold environment? Are you comfortable working in the meat industry (pork)? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

For our client’s deboning department, we are looking for a motivated employee with experience as a butcher, meat deboner, or within the meat processing industry.Your Profile

• Experience as a butcher, deboner, or within the meat industry is a strong asset.
• You are motivated and enjoy hands-on work.
• You preferably speak and understand at least two of the following languages: Dutch, English, or Polish.
• If you speak one of these languages well, you are also welcome to apply.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.

Your Responsibilities

• Deboning and processing pork products.
• Working according to quality, hygiene, and safety standards.
• Cooperating with colleagues in a production environment.
• Keeping your workplace clean, organized, and safe.

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

Are you someone who enjoys working with precision and finds satisfaction in quality control? As a quality control associate, you’ll ensure that goods are properly inspected, counted, and recorded. You’ll maintain an overview, quickly identify discrepancies, and make sure everything is correct down to the smallest detail. You’ll work a fixed late shift from 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.

BelPro Chocolate Masters is looking for an experienced, hands-on 
Chocolate Process Operator to join our growing production team in Duffel, Belgium.
 

The role focuses on operating, monitoring and adjusting industrial chocolate processing equipment, including mixing, refining, conching and tempering, with occasional support for chocolate drops production.
 

Previous practical experience in chocolate refining, conching or tempering is mandatory.
 

Languages: Dutch and English are both required. French and Arabic are advantages.
 

We offer a full-time position, initially temporary, with the possibility of permanent employment.
 

Please see the attached PDF for the complete job description and application details.

As a Back-up Team Leader, you are the right hand of the team leader. You take over responsibilities during their absence and assist in managing a warehouse team on a daily basis. Together, you ensure smooth operations, high quality, and a positive working atmosphere.

Your responsibilities:

• Support and replace the team leader in daily operations
• Coordinate and motivate team members on the shop floor
• Monitor productivity, quality, and safety
• Report progress and issues to management

Inetum is a European leader supporting organizations as they navigate continuous technological change.

With deep industry expertise, a strong innovation culture, and a scalable international model, we help clients transform their operations and generate sustainable impact across business and society.

Guided by European values, we empower local businesses to create positive impact and unlock society's full potential. This vision drives us to deliver on our promises, attract the best talent, and turn uncertainty into opportunity, building a future where technology unleashes the possibilities within us all.
Job description

Are you a freelance Java Developer, DevOps Engineer or Solution Architect looking for your next challenge?

We are continuously looking for experienced Java professionals for a variety of IT projects across Antwerp, Brussels, and hybrid working environments.

You will contribute to innovative software projects involving Java development, cloud-native applications, DevOps practices, software architecture, and digital transformation initiatives. Whether you are a senior developer, an architect, or a technical lead specialist, we would love to hear from you.
Project opportunities

Assignments may include:

• Java Development

• Senior Java Development

• DevOps Engineering

• Solution Architecture

• Software Architecture

• API and Integration Projects

• Application Modernization Initiatives

• MicroServices and Event-Driven Architectures

Interested?

Not available right now? No problem.

Feel free to send us your CV, areas of expertise, availability, and daily rate. We will get in touch as soon as we identify an opportunity that matches your profile.

Stay connected and be the first to hear about exciting freelance Java, DevOps, Cloud, and architecture opportunities across belgium.

Depending on the project, you may work with technologies such as

• Java 17 and Java 21

• Spring Boot

• Azure Cloud

• TerraForm

• Docker

• Kubernetes

• GitHub

• GitHub Actions

• CI/CD Pipelines

• REST APIs

• MicroServices

• Event-Driven Architectures

• SQL Databases

Who we are looking for

• Experience as a Java Developer, DevOps Engineer or Architect

• Strong knowledge of modern Java technologies and software engineering practices

• Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments

• Familiarity with cloud platforms

• Strong analytical and communication skills

• Available as a freelancer or open to future freelance opportunities

• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French

Your responsibilities as a Senior Treasury Analyst :

• Manage liquidity, cash flow planning and day-to-day treasury operations across multiple entities.
• Oversee international banking relationships, cross-border payments and multi-currency activities.
• Develop and improve treasury processes, policies and internal controls.
• Work with Treasury Management Systems.
• Support treasury transformation through automation, system improvements and process standardisation.
• Analyse and optimise treasury data.
• Collaborate with Finance and other stakeholders across an international organisation.
• Contribute to treasury activities in a rapidly evolving, high-growth environment.
 

 

About the candidate :

• You have minimum 5 years of experience in corporate treasury or cash management within an international, multi-entity environment.
• You bring strong expertise in liquidity management, treasury operations and international banking.
• You have hands-on experience with a Treasury Management System.
• You have experience improving treasury processes, policies and control frameworks.
• You bring a proactive, structured and accountable approach, with the ability to work independently.
• You are a strong team player who communicates effectively across different functions and stakeholders.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-changing and sometimes ambiguous environment.
• You speak fluent English; no other languages are required.

As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments. 

Your key responsibilities include:
  
• Planning, organizing, and supervising daily operations to meet short- and long-term goals, while ensuring budget, deadlines, and safety standards are met in an automated environment. 
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture. 
• Developing strategic business plans for the short, medium, and long term for your departments. 
• Taking necessary actions to achieve performance objectives by defining and monitoring team KPIs, while effectively managing operational costs. 
• Leading, coaching, evaluating, and developing your teams (approx. 150 people) in collaboration with Team Leaders and Leads. Communication is central to your role—both with your teams and social partners. 
• Managing and optimizing automated processes with a continuous improvement mindset.  
This role requires adaptability, versatility, and a proactive approach to overcoming daily challenges and driving operational excellence.

Education and technical skills: 
 
• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in a similar role within an automated/production environment. 
• Proficiency in WMS, WCS, and AS400 systems. 
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook). 
• Strong working knowledge of English.  
Your personality and soft skills:
  
• Leadership – You are a driver of change and adapt easily to a constantly evolving environment. 
• Communication – You adjust your communication to suit your audience and actively listen. 
• Customer & results orientation – You go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction. 
• Stress management – You remain positive and composed when facing day-to-day challenges. 
• Conflict resolution & negotiation – You are assertive and diplomatic when managing tensions. 
• Attention to detail – You are uncompromising when it comes to safety and adherence to procedures and workplace rules.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk. 

User support
  
• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site 
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals 
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support 
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN) 
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)  
Access and security
  
• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures 
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)  
Hardware and lifecycle
  
• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals) 
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights) 
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals 
• Tickets, escalation and coordination 
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…) 
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs 
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers 
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions 
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)  
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.
 
THE TEAM & THE MANAGER
 
Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential 
 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT 
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support 
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written 
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA 
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity  
Assets
  
• Knowledge of Arabic 
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer 
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment 
• IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)  
Soft skills
  
• Customer focus and service mindset 
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management 
• Clear communication with non-technical users 
• Hands-on, proactive attitude
